findings.message: The first peroxide charge is explicitly a 30% solution in water. Naming the reagent only H2O2 omits its specified formulation.

findings.quote: the  aqueous  layer  was  extracted  with  Et2O  (2  x  25  mL).  The  combined  organic  extracts  were  washed  with  brine  (1  x  30  mL)
findings.message: The two extraction steps retain organic extracts, and the brine wash retains the combined organic phase. These retained phases are not unknown merely because their top/bottom positions are unspecified. The aqueous raffinate must also remain available between the two extractions.
The method field reduces the explicitly specified preparative thin-layer chromatography to generic chromatography.
